items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: This is another photograph of the Al Streaming Band... There. Yeah, that's Santo Pecoraro, way in the back on drums... is myself, Bob Coquille on string bass.

ctx.x: This is a different kind of picture because you've got Cowbell, Maracas, and Clave's in it.

There. Yeah, that's Santo Pecoraro, way in the back on drums. This is another photograph of the Al Streaming Band, which was taken in one of the local hotels here. I don't remember which one. I think it might be the Roosevelt Hotel, and it shows Harold Geroza, who has since passed away. And just behind Harold Geroza, the sax player, is Richard Bing Crosby, who today still plays music, but he also teaches French at Holy Cross College. And behind Richard Bing Crosby, the trumpet man, is myself, Bob Coquille on…
As far as I know. Right, he's been here so long, I just assume he's still there.
